instructions:
1. Stand in front of a bench, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
2. Place your right foot flat on the bench.
3. Push through your right heel to stand up on the bench and drive your left knee up toward your chest.
4. Lower your left foot back to the floor, then step your right foot down.
5. Switch legs and repeat.
Repeat.
tips:
1. Drive through the heel of the foot on the bench, do not push off the back foot.
2. Place your whole foot on the bench to stay stable.
3. Control the step down slowly.
4. Keep your torso upright and core braced for balance.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
2. Keep your legs nearly straight with only a slight knee bend.
3. Hinge at your hips and lower the dumbbells toward the floor, keeping your back flat and the weights close to your legs.
4. Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back flat, do not round your shoulders.
2. Brace your core throughout to protect your spine.
3. Hinge from the hips, not the waist.
4. Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended straight above your chest.
3. Brace your core and lift your upper back off the floor, pushing the dumbbell straight up toward the ceiling.
4. Keep your arms straight throughout.
5. Lower your upper back to the floor with control.
Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight, do not bend the elbows.
2. Push the dumbbell straight up, not forward.
3. Exhale as you crunch up, inhale as you lower.
4. Use a light weight and move with control.

instructions:
1. Lie flat on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell with both hands, arms extended straight above your chest.
3. Lift your upper body off the floor while twisting your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell toward your right side.
4. Lower your upper body back to the floor with control, arms still extended.
5. Repeat the movement twisting to the left, alternating sides.
Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your arms straight, do not bend the elbows.
2. Use a light weight to keep control.
3. Exhale as you twist up, inhale as you lower.
4. Lead the twist with your core, not your arms.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
2. Keep your legs straight but not locked.
3. Hinge at your hips and push your hips back, lowering the dumbbells toward the floor with a flat back.
4. Keep the dumbbells close to your legs and lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
5. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core throughout to support your spine.
2. Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
3. Hinge from the hips, not the waist.
4. Keep your back flat, do not round it.
